speaker: Doctor
text: Does the mass feel hard and fixed to the surrounding tissue, or is it soft and mobile? Have you noticed any skin changes like dimpling or redness over the area?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Presence of a left breast mass. I also have Rapid increase in size of the mass, No skin or nipple changes, No pain associated with the mass.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the rapid growth over just four weeks, I need to rule out aggressive malignancies or inflammatory processes. REQUEST TEST: Mammography, Ultrasound_Breast, Core_Needle_Biopsy

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Mammography: Smooth polylobulated mass in the left breast. Biopsy: Microscopic description shows leaf-like structures with stromal cellular overgrowth.

speaker: Doctor
text: The biopsy showing leaf-like structures with stromal overgrowth is characteristic of a phyllodes tumor. Given the rapid growth, we need to distinguish between benign, borderline, or malignant subtypes. Are there any signs of necrosis or high mitotic activity noted in the biopsy report?

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: No significant past medical or surgical history. No family history of breast cancer. Social history: Non-smoker, moderate alcohol use. Elementary school teacher.

speaker: Doctor
text: The biopsy description of leaf-like structures with stromal cellular overgrowth is pathognomonic for a phyllodes tumor. DIAGNOSIS READY: Phyllodes tumor of the breast
